name: recall-study-assistant
description: Recall — study-assistant flashcard app. Two independent projects: frontend/ (React + Vite) and server/ (Express). This root package.json is a convenience layer only — each project has its own package.json and installs/runs on its own.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,frontend -c magenta,blue "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
